description: Implementation of WebSocketDeflateStream class handling deflation and inflation of WebSocket frames with compression, decompression, and stream management.

classes.name: WebSocketDeflateStream
classes.description: Handles WebSocket frame compression and decompression with deflate stream management.

methods.name: ReadFrames
methods.description: Reads WebSocket frames and inflates compressed frames if necessary.

methods.name: WriteFrames
methods.description: Deflates frames and writes them to the stream.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of a read operation, handling inflation.

methods.name: OnMessageStart
methods.description: Prepares for message compression based on prediction.

methods.name: AppendCompressedFrame
methods.description: Creates a compressed frame from deflater output.

methods.name: AppendPossiblyCompressedMessage
methods.description: Handles frames that may or may not be compressed based on effectiveness.

methods.name: InflateAndReadIfNecessary
methods.description: Inflates frames and reads more if needed.
